children.title: Epistemic Justice and Foundational Assumptions in AI Metareasoning

detail.title: Epistemic Justice and Foundational Assumptions in AI Metareasoning
detail.summary: Metareasoning frameworks, such as those addressing resource partition, can be extended by epistemic justice methodologies to identify bias not as an error, but as encoded knowledge, allowing for contestable assumption correction.
detail.reason: Incorporating structural knowledge from epistemic reasoning and reinforcement learning frameworks into the metareasoning-partition model.
